verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents support for an extended AgentSkills standard with optional keyword triggers, and lets SDK users define custom agents with their own system prompts. Both are ways to inject project-specific guidance, but neither citation describes a repo-level context file that the agent loads automatically to learn codebase conventions. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented repository context/conventions file (e.g., a checked-in instructions file auto-loaded per repo), evidence that it shapes planning and code generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
